correctness.rationale: The 21 edge-vertices and their open neighborhoods define the exact face set; exhaustive verification enumerates 18,494 nonempty simplices. The deterministic toggle matching contains 9,120 pairs, leaves only critical cells (1 in dimension 0, 246 in dimension 3, 7 in dimension 4), and is acyclic by complete topological sorting of all 98,805 covering incidences. The signed integral algebraic-Morse differential 246 by 7 is identically zero, checked coefficientwise by exact unit-pivot elimination on the actual bundled verifier. The 3-skeleton is a wedge of 246 three-spheres and Hurewicz identifies each attaching map of a four-cell with its integer boundary column, hence all seven maps are nullhomotopic. Independent full face comparison \(B_{7,2}\)=\(N(T_7)\) plus seven full stars and Jonsson’s known \(B_{7,2}\) homotopy plus relative long exact sequence reproduce both integral homology ranks, but do not substitute for the homotopy proof. No unproved infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The triangular graphs form a canonical strongly regular line-graph family. \(T_7\) is the first case with nonzero neighborhood-complex mod-two homology in two dimensions, already a published structural cutoff. The full integral homotopy type is a natural missing invariant: it distinguishes null from potentially nontrivial attaching maps not decided by the prior homology classification. The seven full-star exceptions to Jonsson’s general unbalanced-bipartite wedge theorem give an independent object-level reason to study exactly this case. A complete explicit 9,120-pair acyclic Morse reduction and zero integer attaching matrix provide reusable topology and an independently checkable exact reference case rather than merely a numerical recomputation.
